texts.NIV84: My son, do not forget my teaching, but keep my commands in your heart,
texts.KJV: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
texts.NKJV:
My son, do not forget my law,
But let your heart keep my commands;
texts.DRB: My son, forget not my law, and let thy heart keep my commandments.

texts.NIV84: for they will prolong your life many years and bring you prosperity.
texts.KJV: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.
texts.NKJV:
For length of days and long life
And peace they will add to you.
texts.DRB: For they shall add to thee length of days, and years of life and peace.

texts.NIV84: Let love and faithfulness never leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.
texts.KJV: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
texts.DRB: Let not mercy and truth leave thee, put them about thy neck, and write them in the tables of thy heart:

texts.NIV84: Then you will win favor and a good name in the sight of God and man.
texts.KJV: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
texts.NKJV:
And so find favor and high esteem
In the sight of God and man.
texts.DRB: And thou shalt And grace and good understanding before God and men.

texts.NIV84: Trust in the LORD with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding;
texts.KJV: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
texts.NKJV:
Trust in the Lord with all your heart,
And lean not on your own understanding;
texts.DRB: Have confidence in the Lord with all thy heart, and lean not upon thy own prudence.

texts.NIV84: in all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
texts.KJV: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
texts.NKJV:
In all your ways acknowledge Him,
And He shall direct your paths.
texts.DRB: In all thy ways think on him, and he will direct thy steps.

texts.NIV84: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and shun evil.
texts.KJV: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the Lord, and depart from evil.
texts.NKJV:
Do not be wise in your own eyes;
Fear the Lord and depart from evil.
texts.DRB: Be not wise in thy own conceit: fear God, and depart from evil:

texts.NIV84: This will bring health to your body and nourishment to your bones.
texts.KJV: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
texts.NKJV:
It will be health to your flesh,
And strength to your bones.
texts.DRB: For it shall be health to thy navel, and moistening to thy bones.

texts.NIV84: Honor the LORD with your wealth, with the firstfruits of all your crops;
texts.KJV: Honour the Lord with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
texts.NKJV:
Honor the Lord with your possessions,
And with the firstfruits of all your increase;
texts.DRB: Honour the Lord with thy substance, and give him of the first of all thy fruits :

texts.NIV84: then your barns will be filled to overflowing, and your vats will brim over with new wine.
texts.KJV: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
texts.NKJV:
So your barns will be filled with plenty,
And your vats will overflow with new wine.
texts.DRB: And thy barns shall be filled with abundance, and thy presses shall run over with wine.

texts.NIV84: My son, do not despise the LORD's discipline and do not resent his rebuke,
texts.KJV: My son, despise not the chastening of the Lord; neither be weary of his correction:
texts.NKJV:
My son, do not despise the chastening of the Lord,
Nor detest His correction;
texts.DRB: My son, reject not the correction of the Lord: and do not faint when thou art chastised by him:

texts.NIV84: because the LORD disciplines those he loves, as a father the son he delights in.
texts.KJV: For whom the Lord loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
texts.NKJV:
For whom the Lord loves He corrects,
Just as a father the son in whom he delights.
texts.DRB: For whom the Lord loveth, he chastiseth: and as a father in the son he pleaseth himself.

texts.NIV84: Blessed is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gains understanding,
texts.KJV: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
texts.NKJV:
Happy is the man who finds wisdom,
And the man who gains understanding;
texts.DRB: Blessed is the man that findeth wisdom and is rich in prudence:

texts.NIV84: for she is more profitable than silver and yields better returns than gold.
texts.KJV: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
texts.NKJV:
For her proceeds are better than the profits of silver,
And her gain than fine gold.
texts.DRB: The purchasing thereof is better than the merchandise of silver, and her fruit than the chiefest and purest gold:

texts.NIV84: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.
texts.KJV: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
texts.NKJV:
She is more precious than rubies,
And all the things you may desire cannot compare with her.
texts.DRB: She is more precious than all riches : and all the things that are desired, are not to be compared with her.

texts.NIV84: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.
texts.KJV: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.
texts.NKJV:
Length of days is in her right hand,
In her left hand riches and honor.
texts.DRB: Length of days is in her right hand, and in her left hand riches and glory.

texts.NIV84: Her ways are pleasant ways, and all her paths are peace.
texts.KJV: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
texts.NKJV:
Her ways are ways of pleasantness,
And all her paths are peace.
texts.DRB: Her ways are beautiful ways, and all her paths are peaceable.

texts.NIV84: She is a tree of life to those who embrace her; those who lay hold of her will be blessed.
texts.KJV: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.
texts.NKJV:
She is a tree of life to those who take hold of her,
And happy are all who retain her.
texts.DRB: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold on her: and he that shall retain her is blessed.

texts.NIV84: By wisdom the LORD laid the earth's foundations, by understanding he set the heavens in place;
texts.KJV: The Lord by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
texts.NKJV:
The Lord by wisdom founded the earth;
By understanding He established the heavens;
texts.DRB: The Lord by wisdom hath founded the earth, hath established the heavens by prudence.

texts.NIV84: by his knowledge the deeps were divided, and the clouds let drop the dew.
texts.KJV: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
texts.NKJV:
By His knowledge the depths were broken up,
And clouds drop down the dew.
texts.DRB: By his wisdom the depths have broken out, and the clouds grow thick with dew

texts.NIV84: My son, preserve sound judgment and discernment, do not let them out of your sight;
texts.KJV: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
texts.NKJV:
My son, let them not depart from your eyes—
Keep sound wisdom and discretion;
texts.DRB: My son, let not these things depart from thy eyes: keep the law and counsel:

texts.NIV84: they will be life for you, an ornament to grace your neck.
texts.KJV: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
texts.NKJV:
So they will be life to your soul
And grace to your neck.
texts.DRB: And there shall be life to thy soul, and grace to thy mouth.

texts.NIV84: Then you will go on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble;
texts.KJV: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
texts.NKJV:
Then you will walk safely in your way,
And your foot will not stumble.
texts.DRB: Then shalt thou walk confidently in thy way, and thy foot shall not stumble:

texts.NIV84: when you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.
texts.KJV: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
texts.NKJV:
When you lie down, you will not be afraid;
Yes, you will lie down and your sleep will be sweet.
texts.DRB: If thou sleep, thou shalt not fear: thou shalt rest, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

texts.NIV84: Have no fear of sudden disaster or of the ruin that overtakes the wicked,
texts.KJV: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
texts.NKJV:
Do not be afraid of sudden terror,
Nor of trouble from the wicked when it comes;
texts.DRB: Be not afraid of sudden fear, nor of the power of the wicked falling upon thee.

texts.NIV84: for the LORD will be your confidence and will keep your foot from being snared.
texts.KJV: For the Lord shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
texts.NKJV:
For the Lord will be your confidence,
And will keep your foot from being caught.
texts.DRB: For the Lord will be at thy side, and will keep thy foot that thou be not taken.

texts.NIV84: Do not withhold good from those who deserve it, when it is in your power to act.
texts.KJV: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
texts.NKJV:
Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due,
When it is in the power of your hand to do so.
texts.DRB: Do not withhold him from doing good, who is able: if thou art able, do good thyself also.

texts.NIV84: Do not say to your neighbor, "Come back later; I'll give it tomorrow"- when you now have it with you.
texts.KJV: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
texts.NKJV:
Do not say to your neighbor,
“Go, and come back,
And tomorrow I will give it,”
When you have it with you.
texts.DRB: Say not to thy friend: Go, and come again: and to morrow I will give to thee: when thou canst give at present.

texts.NIV84: Do not plot harm against your neighbor, who lives trustfully near you.
texts.KJV: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
texts.NKJV:
Do not devise evil against your neighbor,
For he dwells by you for safety’s sake.
texts.DRB: Practise not evil against thy friend, when he hath confidence in thee.

texts.NIV84: Do not accuse a man for no reason- when he has done you no harm.
texts.KJV: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
texts.NKJV:
Do not strive with a man without cause,
If he has done you no harm.
texts.DRB: Strive not against a man without cause, when he hath done thee no evil.

texts.NIV84: Do not envy a violent man or choose any of his ways,
texts.KJV: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
texts.NKJV:
Do not envy the oppressor,
And choose none of his ways;
texts.DRB: Envy not the unjust man, and do not follow his ways:

texts.NIV84: for the LORD detests a perverse man but takes the upright into his confidence.
texts.KJV: For the froward is abomination to the Lord: but his secret is with the righteous.
texts.NKJV:
For the perverse person is an abomination to the Lord,
But His secret counsel is with the upright.
texts.DRB: For every mocker is an abomination to the Lord, and his communication is with the simple.

texts.NIV84: The LORD's curse is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the home of the righteous.
texts.KJV: The curse of the Lord is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
texts.NKJV:
The curse of the Lord is on the house of the wicked,
But He blesses the home of the just.
texts.DRB: Want is from the Lord in the house of the wicked: but the habitations of the just shall be blessed.

texts.NIV84: He mocks proud mockers but gives grace to the humble.
texts.KJV: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
texts.NKJV:
Surely He scorns the scornful,
But gives grace to the humble.
texts.DRB: He shall scorn the scorners, and to the meek he will give grace.

texts.NIV84: The wise inherit honor, but fools he holds up to shame.
texts.KJV: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
texts.NKJV:
The wise shall inherit glory,
But shame shall be the legacy of fools.
texts.DRB: The wise shall possess glory: the promotion of fools is disgrace.
